title: every-class-that-can-watch-can-be-sent-back-to-fixme
intention: Every node class that can carry a WATCHME and has a BUILDME on its path — bug v1, concept-piece v1, skill v2 — carries the same FIXME repair edge code-seam v2 does, so a WATCHME that cannot name its receiver can go back for fixing whatever class the ticket is.
why: A WATCHME that cannot name its receiver goes back for fixing (Akien, answer to open-291189a9766a). For a skill, bug or concept-piece ticket that answer cannot execute: the class vocabulary has no FIXME, so the watch verb refuses and the ticket stays at WATCHME looking healthy while its watch can never report — measured 2026-10-03 on 18693659d16b.
traces_to: Akien's answer to open-291189a9766a ('if the WATCHME step is incomplete ... then it's a fault and goes back for fixing'), which names no class exception; Law 4 (the rule is physics in the class vocabulary, not a code-seam-only accident); ticket 72d2f79daf0a, which gave code-seam the edge.
how: Add `repair_summons: {"FIXME": "BUILDME"}` to bug.json v1, concept-piece.json v1 and skill.json v2 in CairnCommons/node_classes, with the why; transitions.py already reads repair_summons generically (lines 671, 1940), so the edge should need no code. A proof drives a skill@v2 WATCHME ticket fixture through the back-edge to FIXME and the FIXME exit gate, and asserts every WATCHME-carrying class with BUILDME on its path declares the edge. Then 18693659d16b and the other standing skill@v2 WATCHME ticket can be sent to FIXME through the watch verb. host-seam v1 (no BUILDME on its path) is NOT in scope: where its FIXME re-enters is a question for Akien, bound to this ticket.
falsifier: Done when the watch verb, handed holds=False for a skill@v2 ticket at WATCHME, answers acted='fixme' and the ticket's cursor stands at [FIXME]; and a census over node_classes finds no WATCHME-carrying version with BUILDME on its path lacking repair_summons. Wrong intent if Akien rules that a non-code-seam WATCHME without a receiver should go somewhere other than back for fixing.
watchme: none, because the falsifier is measured at PROVED, not after: the live post that sends /home/akien/dev/src/CairnCommons/tickets/18693659d16b-skills-migrate-one-blow.json to FIXME is the one event the intention exists for, and it happens inside the build
children: none, because the host-seam half is a sibling ticket cast separately (it carries a question for Akien), not a deconstruction of this one; the edit is three class files and one proof
builder_notes: Proof first (red), then the three class writes, then the live post. No code in cairn/tools/base/transitions.py changes; if the proof stays red after the class writes, the reader is not class-agnostic and the ticket goes back to FIXME naming the line.

decisions.text: D1: the proof — create cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_every_watching_class_can_fixme.py with exactly two teeth, PROVES = {'5f217a2d4bd6': {'1': 'test_every_watching_class_that_builds_declares_the_fixme_edge', '2': 'test_a_back_edge_lands_at_fixme_on_every_watching_class'}}. It reads the LIVE node classes at transitions._NODE_CLASSES (else ~/dev/src/CairnCommons/node_classes, as cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_fixme.py does). Tooth 1: collect every (class, version) whose workflow has 'WATCHME' in free_summons and 'BUILDME' in path; assert {'code-seam@v2','skill@v2','bug@v1','concept-piece@v1'} are all among them (non-hollow floor), and that each declares repair_summons == {'FIXME': 'BUILDME'}. Tooth 2: for each such class, render its path with the cursor on PROVEME ('<cls>@<ver>: A -> [PROVEME] -> B'), call transitions.emit(that, 'FIXME', history_path, state_path, node_class_root=<the live classes dir>, ticket='every_class_fixme_fixture_<cls>', missing=['the receiver is unnamed']) with history/state in scratch_dir('every_class_fixme_fixture_<cls>_')/'comp', and assert the result's here == 'FIXME', its cursor == path.index('BUILDME') - 1, and the last history row has direction 'back'. Run as a script through print_teeth_main(__file__) from cairn.tools.proof_coverage. It must be RED before D2 (both teeth fail: skill@v2 lacks the edge; emit raises IllegalTransition).

D2: the class writes — in each of /home/akien/dev/src/CairnCommons/node_classes/bug.json (workflow_versions.v1), /home/akien/dev/src/CairnCommons/node_classes/concept-piece.json (workflow_versions.v1) and /home/akien/dev/src/CairnCommons/node_classes/skill.json (workflow_versions.v2), add the key "repair_summons": {"FIXME": "BUILDME"} to that version's object, and append to that version's 'why' the sentence: ' REPAIR EDGE added 2026-10-03 (ticket 5f217a2d4bd6): a WATCHME that cannot name its receiver goes back for fixing (answer to open-291189a9766a), which needs FIXME in the vocabulary of every class that can watch and builds; the edge adds no backbone position, so standing strings are unchanged (precedent: 72d2f79daf0a widened code-seam v2 in place).' Each write goes through the artifact door: build the new JSON in a scratch file (json.dumps(d, indent=2) + newline, matching the stored escaping — compare `git diff --stat` shows only the added lines), then `bin/cairn artifact write <path> --verb cast --why '5f217a2d4bd6: FIXME repair edge' --from <scratch file>`. host-seam.json is NOT touched.

D3: proofs green — run python3 cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_every_watching_class_can_fixme.py and python3 cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_fixme.py; both exit 0. Then seal with bin/cairn test --seal --timeout 900 cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_every_watching_class_can_fixme.py cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_fixme.py, and commit both repos (git add -A && git commit in /home/akien/dev/src/cairn, then the same in /home/akien/dev/src/CairnCommons).

D4: the live measurement — once PROVED, post to harbor_master's watch verb for 18693659d16b exactly as the scratch unrec.py does: reach('harbor_master').request(sender='cc', to='harbor_master', verb='watch', why='3c035a838446: no probe exists to report this watch', body={'ticket': '18693659d16b', 'holds': False, 'finding': <the finding text stated in 3c035a838446's decisions>}); assert the reply body has accepted True and acted 'fixme', and that /home/akien/dev/src/CairnCommons/tickets/18693659d16b-skills-migrate-one-blow.json's workflow_and_state carries '[FIXME'. That post is ticket 3c035a838446's step, resumed after this ticket is PROVED; it is listed here because it is this ticket's falsifier observed live.

Signatures, read 2026-10-03: transitions.emit(workflow_str: str, target: str, *, history_path=None, state_path=None, node_class_root=<Path>, **journal_extra) -> str — it RETURNS THE NEW WORKFLOW STRING; pass it to transitions.parse_workflow(s) -> Workflow, whose .here (the cursor's summons name), .cursor (int index) and .path (tuple of summons names, FIXME included once inserted) the tooth reads. history_path/state_path are paths to files that need not exist yet (emit creates them); journal_extra keys (ticket=..., missing=[...]) are journaled into the history row. cairn.tools.scratch.scratch.scratch_dir(prefix: str) -> Path returns a fresh empty directory. cairn.tools.charter.projector.read_history(path: str) -> list[dict] returns the history rows; the last row's 'direction' is 'back' for a back-edge. test_fixme.py's test_a_back_edge_lands_at_fixme_before_buildme is the working example of exactly this call shape.

Structure confirmed 2026-10-03: CairnCommons/node_classes/bug.json, concept-piece.json and skill.json each have a top-level 'workflow_versions' object; bug and concept-piece carry key 'v1', skill carries 'v2' (and a v1 not touched). Each version object has keys path, skippable_summons, free_summons, why. repair_summons is a NEW key inside that version object (sibling of free_summons) — exactly where code-seam.json's workflow_versions.v2.repair_summons already sits.

cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_fixme.py exists (ticket 72d2f79daf0a, PROVED) and is runnable as python3 cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_fixme.py, exit 0 when green; it is re-run here only as the regression check that code-seam's edge still works.

The finding text, verbatim from 3c035a838446 decision D6: "its watchme names cairn/machines/learning_block/probes/akien_gate_dial.py, which does not exist and never has (find + git log --diff-filter=D, 2026-10-03), so nothing can post for this watch and no receiver can use it (Akien's answer to open-291189a9766a: no sensible receiver -> FIXME)". harbor_master's watch reply: body = reply.get('body', reply), a dict with keys accepted (bool), verb, device, ticket, acted ('fixme' when the ticket was sent back, 'none' otherwise) and said. 18693659d16b stands at [WATCHME(akien-gate-dial):waiting] (read 2026-10-03).
